findings: JUDGING SET RECONCILED. PLAN lists 20 items; only 11 of them name any of my 9 dotted paths in judges: front-matter (RI-AI07 npc.population, RI-CAM05 interior.named, RI-CHR02 faction.presence, RI-CRM01 persistence.state, RI-DLG02 settlement.anatomy, RI-DLG03 persistence.state, RI-LOR06 settlement.anatomy, RI-STL02 locks.security+property.ownership, RI-TRV01 settlement.anatomy, RI-WLD08 npc.population+npc.schedule, RI-WLD13 interior.continuity). The other 9 (RI-LOR01/02/04, RI-PRG03, RI-QST03/07/08, RI-WLD03, RI-WLD07) judge COARSE legacy path names: world.settlements, world.interiors, npc.population, npc.services, quest.hubs, world.locks, world.property, world.settlement.content, world.factions. So the item set must be assembled by mapping coarse->fine, not by exact string match. RI-WLD03 (the settlement-anatomy bar, blind_pair:yes) is in the coarse group and is the single most load-bearing item for this piece.

SURVEY, as shipped: game/data/world/settlements/ contains ONE file (thorn.json). game/data/world/interiors/ contains TWO (thorn-hall.json, writ-house.json). game/data/world/property/ contains EIGHT (all 8 settlements named). So 1 of 8 settlements exists as a settlement record, and 2 interiors exist against a wave-3 floor of 250. thorn.json carries an explicit declared_incomplete block naming W1-04 as owner.

CONSUMPTION AUDIT (the RI-MTH07 answer for this piece). game/data/world/settlements/*.json is loaded into Engine data as out.settlements and READ BY NOTHING — engine.js:5120's `named.settlements` is roads.named_routes, a different object. game/data/world/interiors/*.json is read by exactly ONE expression: `Object.keys(d.interiors).length` in getWorldStats(). So settlement anatomy and interior data are, today, a census and nothing else.

NPC SCHEDULES ARE THE TWELFTH-AND-THIRTEENTH FAILURE OF THE SAME KIND. game/data/npcs/*.json records carry a `schedule: [{from,to,at}]` array. makeNPC() in game/src/sim/npc.js does not even COPY the field onto the entity, and stepNPCs() (which IS live — step.js:124 calls it) only turns people to face the player. Nobody moves, ever. Only 5 of 76 NPCs declare a schedule at all.

PROPERTY AND LOCKS ALREADY HAVE LIVE CONSUMERS, built by W1-15: Engine.takeObject() reads zone.contents[].owner/owner_scope and files a real crime; Engine.lockBegin() reads zone.locks[]; sim/stealth/theft.js:74 reads zone.class and zone.faction. These two of my nine paths are NOT the greenfield the others are — do not rebuild them, extend them.
BUT zone.schedule {open_h, close_h} on all 8 property files is read by nothing. Trespass in theft.js is time-blind: a shop is as much a trespass at noon as at 3am, and a house is as little.

DANGLING INTERIORS: NPC records reference 11 distinct interior ids (barge-hold, blackrose-inn, blackrose-prison, gideon-court, gideon-lowmarket, helstrom-undertemple, lilmoth-customs, lilmoth-yard, stormhold-archive, thorn-hall, writ-house). Only 2 of the 11 exist as files in game/data/world/interiors/. Nothing validates this at boot.

env.settlement is WRITTEN BY NOTHING in the world. It exists in makeEnvironment(), is read by sim/quest/topic-supply.js (rumours keyed per town, RI-DLG02) and by engine.js:1517, and the only writer is loadState's patch. Walking into a town does not tell the world you are in it.

TOPIC GATE CHECK (the brief's explicit rule): after slug-normalisation, 9 of 116 topic ids on NPC records do not exist in game/data/dialogue/topics/: lukiul, my-work, the-chapter-s-vote, the-hold, the-interior-s-consent, the-ledger-s-terms, the-list, the-writ, your-hatch-name.
BASELINES BEFORE MY CHANGES, all three green: tools/check-data.mjs exit 0 (366 files indexed), tools/check-content.mjs exit 0, tools/harness/boot-check.mjs exit 0.

Population census as shipped: 76 NPC records across 6 files, spread over 10 settlements + 2 region-level buckets + 13 with settlement=null. Against the wave-3 floor of 269. Settlement records: 1 of 8.

AUTHORED: 8 settlements, 112 named interiors, every tier's named_interiors target hit EXACTLY (26/18/18/12/12/12/7/7) and enterable_pct above target in all eight (70-81.3 vs 64-70). M14 mesh overlap between kits is 0%. Each interior binds `property_zones` to the zones the crime system ALREADY reads, so an interior is a door onto rooms takeObject()/lockBegin() already govern rather than a parallel world.

SUCCESSOR RESUME AUDIT (container restart #2). Far more landed than the previous status recorded. On disk now: 8/8 settlements, 113 interiors, 336 NPC records total (265 with schedules) across 8 pop-*.json + the pre-existing 6 files — ABOVE the wave-3 floor of 269 NPCs. game/src/sim/settlement.js exists and IS on the live step (step.js:23 imports stepSettlement, :128 calls it, before stepNPCs at :131). npc.js now copies schedule onto the entity (line 78) and steps it (slotAt/n.at at 135-157). engine.js:270-275 constructs SettlementSystem and installs sim.populate. trespassCheck() at engine.js:6188 now DERIVES shopOpen from isOpenNow() instead of the hardcoded true. So the three dead-data paths have consumers written; what is NOT yet done is proving them.
next_step: run the four gates, then write tools/world/w1-04-consumption.mjs to prove each path by perturbation in the running world
